text:
Students are asked for a statement about magnetic fields.
Three statements are listed.
1
A magnetic field is described as a region in which a stationary electric charge
experiences a force.
2
The direction of a magnetic field at a point is the direction of the force on an S pole
at that point.
3
The relative strength of a magnetic field is shown by the spacing of the magnetic
field lines.
Which statements are correct for magnetic fields?
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
3 only
subject: Physics
